/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"OrdenesWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderDoc_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Pedido SAE")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderDoc_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFOrderDoc.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Pedido SAE")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderDoc)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderNumPar.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderNumPar_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Consecutivo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFOrderNumPar
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFOrderNumPar_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductNumber_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductNumber.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Producto")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductNumber)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductType_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Producto")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductType_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductType.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Tipo Producto")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductType)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFProductDesc_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductDesc_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFProductDesc.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Descripción")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFProductDesc)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFCustomer_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Código Cliente")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFCustomer_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFCustomer.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Código Cliente")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFCustomer)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFCustomerName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFCustomerName_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFCustomerName.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFCustomerName)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFConsolidatedName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Grupo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFConsolidatedName_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFConsolidatedName.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Grupo")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFConsolidatedName)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderKey_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Key")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderKey_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFOrderKey.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Key")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderKey)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderDate.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderDate_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha de Elaboración")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFOrderDate
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFOrderDate_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderDeliveryDate.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderDeliveryDate_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Fecha de Entrega")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Date = &TFOrderDeliveryDate
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Date = &TFOrderDeliveryDate_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderQuantity.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderQuantity_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cantidad")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFOrderQuantity
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFOrderQuantity_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderPXS.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderPXS_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Millares por Entregar")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFOrderPXS
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFOrderPXS_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderPrice.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderPrice_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Precio")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFOrderPrice
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFOrderPrice_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderTotal.IsEmpty() AND &TFOrderTotal_To.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Total")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Number = &TFOrderTotal
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, false, &CellRow, &FirstColumn + 2, "WWP_TSTo")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 3).Number = &TFOrderTotal_To
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderStatus_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Estatus SAE")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderStatus_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFOrderStatus.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Estatus SAE")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderStatus)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFOrderShipping_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Envío")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderShipping_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFOrderShipping.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Envío")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFOrderShipping)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFFTBCustomer_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente FTB")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFFTBCustomer_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFFTBCustomer.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Cliente FTB")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFFTBCustomer)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'Embarques.OrdenesWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Embarques.OrdenesWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&FirstDataCellRow = &CellRow + 1
	For each DB.Order
		order OrderStatus  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderStatus)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDoc  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDoc)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderNumPar  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderNumPar)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductType  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductDesc  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductDesc)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Customer  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Customer)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order CustomerName  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (CustomerName)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ConsolidatedName  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ConsolidatedName)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderKey  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderKey)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDate  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDate)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDeliveryDate  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDeliveryDate)  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderQuantity  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderQuantity)  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPXS  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderPXS)  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPrice  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderPrice)  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderTotal  when &OrderedBy = 16 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderTotal)  when &OrderedBy = 16 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderShipping  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderShipping)  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order FTBCustomer  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (FTBCustomer)  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using OrdenesWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFOrderDoc, &TFOrderDoc_Sel, &TFOrderNumPar, &TFOrderNumPar_To, &TFProductNumber
					, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFCustomer
					, &TFCustomer_Sel, &TFCustomerName, &TFCustomerName_Sel, &TFConsolidatedName, &TFConsolidatedName_Sel, &TFOrderKey
					, &TFOrderKey_Sel, &TFOrderDate, &TFOrderDate_To, &TFOrderDeliveryDate, &TFOrderDeliveryDate_To, &TFOrderQuantity
					, &TFOrderQuantity_To, &TFOrderPXS, &TFOrderPXS_To, &TFOrderPrice, &TFOrderPrice_To, &TFOrderTotal
					, &TFOrderTotal_To, &TFOrderStatus, &TFOrderStatus_Sel, &TFOrderShipping, &TFOrderShipping_Sel, &TFFTBCustomer
					, &TFFTBCustomer_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDoc'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderDoc)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderNumPar'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderNumPar
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPBaseObjects.ProductNumber)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductType'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductType)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductDesc'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductDesc)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'Customer'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(Customer)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'CustomerName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(CustomerName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ConsolidatedName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ConsolidatedName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderKey'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderKey)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDate'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = OrderDate
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDeliveryDate'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = OrderDeliveryDate
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderQuantity'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderQuantity
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderPXS'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderPXS
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderPrice'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderPrice
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderTotal'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderTotal
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderStatus'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderStatus)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderShipping'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderShipping)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'FTBCustomer'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(FTBCustomer)
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor
	Do 'WriteTotalizers'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteTotalizers'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			Do Case
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDoc'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &CellRow + 1 - &FirstDataCellRow
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderQuantity'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = format(!"=SUM(%1%2:%1%3)", CHR(ASC(!'A') + &VisibleColumnCount), &FirstDataCellRow.ToString().Trim(), &CellRow.ToString().Trim())
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderTotal'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = format(!"=SUM(%1%2:%1%3)", CHR(ASC(!'A') + &VisibleColumnCount), &FirstDataCellRow.ToString().Trim(), &CellRow.ToString().Trim())
			EndCase
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor
	&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn, 1, &VisibleColumnCount).Italic = True
	&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn, 1, &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderDoc", '', !'Pedido SAE', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderNumPar", '', !'Consecutivo', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductNumber", '', !'Producto', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductType", '', !'Tipo Producto', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ProductDesc", '', !'Descripción', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"Customer", '', !'Código Cliente', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"CustomerName", '', !'Cliente', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"ConsolidatedName", '', !'Grupo', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderKey", '', !'Key', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderDate", '', !'Fecha de Elaboración', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderDeliveryDate", '', !'Fecha de Entrega', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderQuantity", '', !'Cantidad', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderPXS", '', !'Millares por Entregar', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderPrice", '', !'Precio', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderTotal", '', !'Total', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderStatus", '', !'Estatus SAE', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"OrderShipping", '', !'Envío', False, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"FTBCustomer", '', !'Cliente FTB', False, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'Embarques.OrdenesWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Embarques.OrdenesWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(LoadGridState.Udp(!"Embarques.OrdenesWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Embarques.OrdenesWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERDOC"
				&TFOrderDoc.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERDOC_SEL"
				&TFOrderDoc_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFORDERNUMPAR"
				&TFOrderNumPar.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
				&TFOrderNumPar_To.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.ValueTo)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER"
				&TFProductNumber.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTNUMBER_SEL"
				&TFProductNumber_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTTYPE"
				&TFProductType.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTTYPE_SEL"
				&TFProductType_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTDESC"
				&TFProductDesc.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRODUCTDESC_SEL"
				&TFProductDesc_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMER"
				&TFCustomer.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMER_SEL"
				&TFCustomer_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMERNAME"
				&TFCustomerName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCUSTOMERNAME_SEL"
				&TFCustomerName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCONSOLIDATEDNAME"
				&TFConsolidatedName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFCONSOLIDATEDNAME_SEL"

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0

		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Embarques.OrdenesWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&FirstDataCellRow = &CellRow + 1
	For each DB.Order
		order OrderStatus  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderStatus)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDoc  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDoc)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderNumPar  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderNumPar)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductNumber  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductNumber)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductType  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductType)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ProductDesc  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ProductDesc)  when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order Customer  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (Customer)  when &OrderedBy = 7 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order CustomerName  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (CustomerName)  when &OrderedBy = 8 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order ConsolidatedName  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (ConsolidatedName)  when &OrderedBy = 9 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderKey  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderKey)  when &OrderedBy = 10 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDate  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDate)  when &OrderedBy = 11 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderDeliveryDate  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderDeliveryDate)  when &OrderedBy = 12 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderQuantity  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderQuantity)  when &OrderedBy = 13 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPXS  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderPXS)  when &OrderedBy = 14 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderPrice  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderPrice)  when &OrderedBy = 15 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderTotal  when &OrderedBy = 16 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderTotal)  when &OrderedBy = 16 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order OrderShipping  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (OrderShipping)  when &OrderedBy = 17 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order FTBCustomer  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (FTBCustomer)  when &OrderedBy = 18 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using OrdenesWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFOrderDoc, &TFOrderDoc_Sel, &TFOrderNumPar, &TFOrderNumPar_To, &TFProductNumber
					, &TFProductNumber_Sel, &TFProductType, &TFProductType_Sel, &TFProductDesc, &TFProductDesc_Sel, &TFCustomer
					, &TFCustomer_Sel, &TFCustomerName, &TFCustomerName_Sel, &TFConsolidatedName, &TFConsolidatedName_Sel, &TFOrderKey
					, &TFOrderKey_Sel, &TFOrderDate, &TFOrderDate_To, &TFOrderDeliveryDate, &TFOrderDeliveryDate_To, &TFOrderQuantity
					, &TFOrderQuantity_To, &TFOrderPXS, &TFOrderPXS_To, &TFOrderPrice, &TFOrderPrice_To, &TFOrderTotal
					, &TFOrderTotal_To, &TFOrderStatus, &TFOrderStatus_Sel, &TFOrderShipping, &TFOrderShipping_Sel, &TFFTBCustomer
					, &TFFTBCustomer_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDoc'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderDoc)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderNumPar'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderNumPar
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductNumber'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPBaseObjects.ProductNumber)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductType'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductType)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ProductDesc'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ProductDesc)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'Customer'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(Customer)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'CustomerName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(CustomerName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'ConsolidatedName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(ConsolidatedName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderKey'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderKey)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDate'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = OrderDate
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDeliveryDate'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Date = OrderDeliveryDate
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderQuantity'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderQuantity
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderPXS'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderPXS
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderPrice'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderPrice
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderTotal'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = OrderTotal
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderStatus'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(OrderStatus)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderShipping'

					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'FTBCustomer'

Sub 'WriteTotalizers'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			Do Case
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderDoc'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Number = &CellRow + 1 - &FirstDataCellRow
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderQuantity'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = format(!"=SUM(%1%2:%1%3)", CHR(ASC(!'A') + &VisibleColumnCount), &FirstDataCellRow.ToString().Trim(), &CellRow.ToString().Trim())
				Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'OrderTotal'
					&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = format(!"=SUM(%1%2:%1%3)", CHR(ASC(!'A') + &VisibleColumnCount), &FirstDataCellRow.ToString().Trim(), &CellRow.ToString().Trim())
			EndCase
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor
	&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn, 1, &VisibleColumnCount).Italic = True
	&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow + 1, &FirstColumn, 1, &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
